meta.title: Arrival
sources: Denis Villeneuve; Ted Chiang Story of Your Life

events.label: Twelve vessels land worldwide
events.description: Twelve enormous alien vessels settle down at sites across the Earth without warning or explanation, and the world holds its breath.

events.label: Louise recruited to Montana site
events.description: Linguist Louise Banks is recruited by the American military to make first contact at the Montana site - to learn what the visitors want by learning how they speak.

events.label: Learning heptapod logograms — nonlinear language
events.description: The aliens communicate in ink-black circular logograms, a written language with no beginning or end - a sign that those who write it experience time nothing like we do.

events.label: Misread 'weapon' / gift of language
events.description: A translated phrase is taken as 'offer weapon' and panic spreads - the word actually means a tool: the gift of their language itself.

events.label: Louise calls Shang with future-given private words
events.description: Louise calls General Shang and recites his wife's dying words - words he gave her only in a future that, from inside her new sense of time, has already happened.

events.label: Nations share data; vessels depart
events.description: The twelve nations share what they have learned, the vessels rise together, and the crisis dissolves into the beginning of understanding.

events.label: Hannah's life (experienced nonlinearly)
events.description: Louise's visions of her daughter Hannah are not memories of the past but knowledge of the future - a whole life seen from both ends at once.

events.label: Hannah's illness/death known in advance
events.description: In those same visions Louise knows Hannah will die young of a rare illness - grief she cannot avoid because it has not even begun.

events.label: Louise chooses life with Ian knowing the cost
events.description: Knowing everything that awaits - the love and the loss both - Louise chooses to have her daughter anyway.

events.label: Future knowledge enables present diplomacy
events.description: The gift works: language learned outside time lets Louise act in the present with knowledge from the future, and that is what saves the standoff.

events.label: Louise learns Heptapod B
events.description: Heptapod B, the aliens' circular script, rewires the mind that studies it until time itself starts running in both directions.

events.label: Future phone call saves diplomacy
events.description: The phone call that defuses the crisis: future knowledge passed backwards to change the present.

events.label: Chooses life with Hannah knowing grief
events.description: Louise's decision to live Hannah's life - every moment of it, loss included - rather than refuse the grief.

events.label: Louise and Ian join contact team
events.description: Louise and physicist Ian join the small team shuttling into the alien shell, trying to bridge two completely different ways of being.

events.label: China/US weapon misread crisis
events.description: China and the United States edge toward attacking the vessels, each reading the aliens' gift as a threat.

events.label: Future Louise's call to Shang saves diplomacy
events.description: Using the private phone number she will one day be given, Louise talks General Shang down from an attack he has already ordered.

events.label: Daughter Hannah life known in advance
events.description: Hannah's short life - birth to teenage death - runs through the film as memory and prophecy at once.

events.label: Chooses to have Hannah despite grief foreknowledge
events.description: Louise chooses to conceive Hannah, accepting in advance the illness and loss that her knowledge of the future has already shown her.

events.label: Names heptapods Abbott and Costello
events.description: The scientists nickname their two aliens Abbott and Costello, after the comedy duo - one talkative, one silent.

events.label: Language rewires Louise temporal cognition
events.description: Studying the heptapod language reshapes Louise's mind until she stops experiencing time as a line and starts receiving it as a whole.

events.label: Ian as father in future memories
events.description: In her visions, Ian is Hannah's father - the marriage she remembers ending is one she has not yet begun.

events.label: Ships depart after gift of language
events.description: Their work done and their gift left behind, the twelve vessels lift off and vanish as quietly as they came.

edges.label: future party gives words used now

ruleEffects.effect: Future memory acts in present without physical travel
Shang's words have no origin outside the loop

outcome.summary: Heptapod language grants simultaneous perception; Louise embraces a known future including loss.
